description: This header file declares external API functions related to the Npt Cmd Carrier component in the ANSC (Advanced Networking Service Container) framework. It contains function prototypes for creating command carrier and command instances, with no implementation details.

methods.name: AnscCreateNptCmdCarrier
methods.description: Creates a new Npt Command Carrier object given an owner context handle.

methods.name: AnscCreateNptCmd
methods.description: Creates a new Npt Command object of a specified type given an owner context handle.
